text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Meconium Ileus

The clinical picture of bilious vomiting, failure to pass meconium at 48 hours, and abdominal distension in a term infant without family history of Hirschsprung's or Cystic Fibrosis strongly points to an obstruction caused by inspissated meconium. The absence of a transition point on prior imaging and the specific history favor meconium ileus over meconium plug syndrome or Hirschsprung's. I recommend a diagnostic contrast enema to confirm microcolon and visualize the distal obstruction.
